title: Don't use a ref to stop the double run

slides.say: Your Effect runs twice in development, so you add a ref to make it run once. It hides the bug instead of fixing it.
Now you only see connecting once. But there is still no cleanup. Navigate away and back, and connections pile up, just like before.

slides.text: The right question: not "how to run once", but "how to work after remounting".
slides.say: The right question is not how to run an Effect once. It is how to make it work after remounting.
The fix is a cleanup that undoes the setup. Then setup, cleanup, setup looks the same to the user as running once.
